title: Al-Baqarah 285: the madd families in one ayah: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-Baqarah 285 to 286; madd laazim and 'aarid
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Baqarah 285 rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 36. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: The madd families
points: Muttasil (hamza in the same word): 4 or 5
Munfasil (hamza in the next word): 4 or 5

arabic.text: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍۢ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ (٢٨٥)

keywords.def: lengthening a sound by a set number of counts
joined: madd and hamza in one word
separate: hamza in the next word

questions.q: Read «بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ» with four counts on the munfasil.
questions.a: bimaaaa unzila ilayhi: four even counts.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: colour each madd in 2:285 by family (natural, muttasil, munfasil, badal, 'aarid). Today's rota group recites 2:285.
questions.a: Madd coloured by family with counts.

questions.q: Extend: explain what 'we hear and we obey' looks like at home.
questions.a: For example: praying when the adhan comes; helping when asked.

questions.q: Stretch: find the waqf signs in 2:285 and say what each allows.
questions.a: ۚ after «وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ» and «رُّسُلِهِۦ»: stop or continue; ۖ after «وَأَطَعْنَا»: continuing is better.
A) muttasil. The madd and the hamza are in the same word.

questions.q: Think again: 2:285 is a long ayah. How can madd help you remember where each part begins?
questions.a: The long sounds mark the phrases: «بِمَآ أُنزِلَ», «وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ», «وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ».
